newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat unions agree increased output plan.
newsitem.headline: Fiat unions agree increased output plan.

text.p: Trades unions at car maker Fiat Auto have given their go ahead to management plans to make new hirings and work extra Saturday shifts to cope with an increase in demand due to the government's new car incentive scheme, union sources said.

Fiat plans to hire 2,030 young people, some on fixed-term contracts, temporarily transfer workers from its Turin Rivalta plant to the city's Mirafiori plant which makes small and medium-sized cars, and introduce 22 extra Saturday shifts.

Fiat's car division expects considerably increased domestic demand following the introduction of a scheme to give bonuses to owners of cars over 10 years who exchange them for scrapping and buy a new model. The scheme runs from January to end-September.
